missing_lines: Reported lines contain inline maths now in LaTeX (A, the families {a_i}, {e_i}, {r_i}, {r_i^*}, {v_i}, {c_i}, G(1-κ,1/B), X_n, p_θ(x_{1:T}|y_{1:T}), the parameter vector and prior specifications, p{θ,σ^2(0),η_{1:T}|y_{1:T}}, O(T^2)) or words glued in the PDF text layer; each line was compared with 220 dpi crops.
number_differences: Differences: the PDF text layer encodes decimal points in maths as a different glyph (0.50, 1.41, 2.83, 0.10, 0.5 appear split), plus exponents/subscripts and ASCII minus in LaTeX; all values (400, 100, 0.50, 1.41, 2.83, 0.10, Be(10,10), Be(4,36), √50, √200, 0.5, 200, 50/100/200, 1000, dates and years, section 5.1) were compared with the image.
